content: Certain medications, including glucocorticoids, statins, and some antipsychotic drugs such as olanzapine, are associated with an increased risk of developing diabetes. These medications necessitate regular monitoring due to their impact on metabolic parameters, including blood glucose levels and body weight. It is recommended to screen for diabetes or prediabetes at the time of initiating these medications, again 12 to 16 weeks after starting the treatment, and subsequently on an annual basis.
